alignmentLegend.built-in-equivalent: Android in-app implementation achieves the same user result
alignmentLegend.system-equivalent: Official Android platform API achieves the result
alignmentLegend.external-collaboration: Verified external app editing round-trip; only accepted manual workflows
alignmentLegend.on-demand-equivalent: Optional installed component completes the workflow with explicit dependency
alignmentLegend.remote-equivalent: User-configured service or host; never claimed as offline parity
alignmentLegend.platform-replacement: Apple-specific or absent capability replaced by an Android approach judged on user result
alignmentLegend.pending-gap: No verifiable implementation path yet; does not satisfy alignment

globalLimitations: Only FND-SHARED-CORE, FND-FLAVOR-EXCLUDE and FND-VISUAL-TOKENS are component-verified for the G01 foundation scope; the other 169 operations remain 'planned' and no future-goal domain feature is implemented or qualified.
The two CHA-ATTACH-* operations are planned contract assets reconciled from plan P2.2/17.5; they do not claim an Android SAF/content-URI ingest, lifecycle adapter, device run or G02 completion.
Cross-device real-time sync (SYNC family) is a separate user decision gate and is not silently promised.
No local LLM on Android: FloeLocalModels/FloeLocalModelCatalog paths are deliberately excluded from this baseline's evidence set.

Fixtures are synthetic and cover coherent operations, not every combination; see FloeAndroid/fixtures/README.md for the explicit gap list (encrypted PDF, DWG, speech audio, declarative attachment scenario contracts).
iOS evidence was re-read from current source on 2026-10-18; historical doc results are dated records, not proof.

The 2026-10-19 native Settings audit identified memory/personalization, global usage, typed global defaults and privacy operations not explicitly represented by the initial 30 G02 operation IDs. The Main-accepted rev3 additive mapping now records 10 SET-family operations and 7 declarative fixture groups at status planned. Candidate counts are 182 operations/40 G02/33 fixtures/36 families/85 packages; the live tree remains 172/30/26/36/85 until Main publishes the candidate. The frozen G01 170-operation/24-fixture receipt and the prior 172-operation attachment reconciliation remain historical records and are not rewritten. No G02 implementation, test pass or device qualification is claimed by this baseline.
